note: Cases copy tests/http_auth_on_client.rs (the six ORB_HTTP_AUTH_ON_CLIENT cases and the three ORB_X_MIXED_RESIDENCE cases, each refusal with its control) and add the effect_site and sexpr_runs_server_effect rules they rest on: http request classes (none, null, literal without auth, literal with auth, non-literal), data effects by entity residence including a persist batch, statically false if and when branches, let pair names and fn parameter lists. The operator sites come from the shapes the goldens feed (the installed table's runsOn). Expected findings carry the code, path, message and suggestion of the Rust validator, severity error.

findings.message: trait "Loader" is [client], so its transitions run on the client, but this `http` carries `auth` — a credential never reaches the client, so only a keyless `http` may run there
findings.suggestion: Drop `auth`, or emit an event from here and make the authenticated call in a trait that runs on the server.
